name: ex_Bank.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-sort Customer) (declare-const mk-Customer Customer)
(declare-datatypes () ((Account (mk-Account (balance Int)(pendingAmount Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Bank (mk-Bank (accounts (Set Ref))(customers (Set Ref))(customerAccount (Set (Tuple2 Ref Ref)))))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-Customer (sel-Customer Customer))
  (lift-Account (sel-Account Account))
  (lift-Bank (sel-Bank Bank))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-Customer ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Customer (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Customer ((this Ref)) Customer
  (sel-Customer (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Account ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Account (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Account ((this Ref)) Account
  (sel-Account (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Bank ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Bank (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Bank ((this Ref)) Bank
  (sel-Bank (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-Customer ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Customer this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Account ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Account this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Bank ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Bank this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ------------------------------
;   Getters for class Account:
; ------------------------------

; --- getters for Account.balance: ---

(define-fun Account!balance ((this Ref)) Int
  (balance (deref-Account this))
)

; --- getters for Account.pendingAmount: ---

(define-fun Account!pendingAmount ((this Ref)) Int
  (pendingAmount (deref-Account this))
)

; ---------------------------
;   Getters for class Bank:
; ---------------------------

; --- getters for Bank.accounts: ---

(define-fun Bank!accounts ((this Ref)) (Set Ref)
  (accounts (deref-Bank this))
)

; --- getters for Bank.customers: ---

(define-fun Bank!customers ((this Ref)) (Set Ref)
  (customers (deref-Bank this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Customer:
; ---------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Customer Customer)



; --------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Account:
; --------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Account Account)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Account.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (Account!balance this) 0)
)

(assert (! (Account.inv1 2) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Account.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (Account!pendingAmount this) (Account!balance this))
)

(assert (! (Account.inv2 2) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun Account.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (Account!pendingAmount this) 0)
)

(assert (! (Account.inv3 2) :named _xkassert2))



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Bank:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-Bank Bank)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Bank.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (Bank!accounts this) ((as const (Set Ref)) false)))
)

(assert (! (Bank.inv1 3) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Bank.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (Bank!customers this) ((as const (Set Ref)) false)))
)

(assert (! (Bank.inv2 3) :named _xkassert4))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-Customer const-1-Customer))
        2 (lift-Account const-2-Account))
        3 (lift-Bank const-3-Bank))
  )
)

(define-fun const-2-Account () Account
  (mk-Account 0 0))
(define-fun const-3-Bank () Bank
  (mk-Bank (store ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false) 4 true)
         ((as const (Array Int Bool)) true)
         ((as const (Array (Tuple2 Int Int) Bool)) true)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (>= (pendingAmount (sel-Account (select heap 2))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (= (accounts (sel-Bank (select heap 3)))
              ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false))))
  (not a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (>= (balance (sel-Account (select heap 2))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (<= (pendingAmount (sel-Account (select heap 2)))
    (balance (sel-Account (select heap 2)))))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (= (customers (sel-Bank (select heap 3)))
              ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false))))
  (not a!1)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun const-1-Customer () Customer
  Customer!val!0)
(define-fun k!heap_full!Account () Bool
  true)
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (lift-Bank (mk-Bank (store ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false)
                                      4
                                      true)
                               ((as const (Array Int Bool)) true)
                               ((as const (Array (Tuple2 Int Int) Bool)) true)))))
  (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                       1
                       (lift-Customer Customer!val!0))
                2
                (lift-Account (mk-Account 0 0)))
         3
         a!1)))
(define-fun k!heap_full!Bank () Bool
  true)
(define-fun k!heap_full!Customer () Bool
  true)
(define-fun k!4 ((x!0 Int)) Bool
  true)
(define-fun k!5 ((x!0 Int)) Bool
  (ite (= x!0 4) true
    false))
